description: The workbook reader of office-com-host.ps1: Snapshot-Excel (whole, and paged by cells and by row blocks, with styles, with a range, with a sheet and range for the values), Snapshot-Selection and Issues-Excel (sampled and financial-model). The workbooks are built by the hosts' own operations in a prepare step, so no binary input is needed. Not covered by these scenarios, which need workbooks only the migration PC can supply (place them in tests/inputs and add a copy step): a Korean-UI Excel with colour number formats, pivots, pictures (with and without alternative text), hidden _xlfn names, an external link and a sheet whose merged cells run past 2,000.

scenarios.description: A workbook with a header block, formulas, error values, a merged area, a hidden row and column, frozen panes, a note, a defined name, validation blocks of two kinds, a colour scale, a table, a chart, page setup and a header, protected: read whole, by cells, with a range, with a sheet and range (values and address), with styles; and its issues.
A sheet of 30 x 20 cells: read in row blocks (more than 500 cells), in blocks that start inside a row, and with styles asked for.
A 60 x 64 range with a merged area inside the first 2,000 cells and one after them, hidden rows and a hidden column: the merged-range walk stops at 2,000 cells.
Dates (number formats), formula errors, booleans and text read as the values the cells hold.
A model with formula rows, a hardcode among them, a hardcode with and without a source note: the financial-model audit with no Checks sheet.
The same kind of model with a Checks sheet holding a failed tie-out.
The selection of a workbook a user's Excel holds, with the snapshot.
